name: Now & Then: A Tale of the End
source:
Now & Then is a story of Jack (or a name of your choosing) Brooks, a widower who lives with his adopted teenage daughter, Carol, during the aftermath of a global pandemic. Throughout the story, players witness the string of events that finds Jack adopting Carol and how they grow into a family unit before the collapse of civilized society. Influenced by Stephen King’s The Stand and numerous zombie movies and books, Now & Then is a tale of survivors learning to cope with the life as it comes to them.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/ilsproductions]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《Now & Then》讲述了鳏夫杰克·布鲁克斯（名字可自定）与十几岁的养女卡萝，在全球大流行病后的生活。故事中，玩家将见证杰克收养卡萝的一连串经历，以及在文明社会崩溃前，两人如何逐渐成为一家人。本作受到斯蒂芬·金的《末日逼近》，以及众多丧尸电影和书籍的启发，讲述幸存者学习面对生活中种种变故的故事。
